def stamp(ts: int) -> str:
    """Format a Unix timestamp (seconds) as UTC ``HH:MM:SS``.

    Uses 24-hour time, zero-padded fields. The time of day is taken
    modulo 86400, so negative timestamps wrap backward within the day
    (e.g. -1 is ``23:59:59``). Pure arithmetic: no system timezone or I/O.
    """
    secs = ts % 86400
    hours = secs // 3600
    minutes = (secs % 3600) // 60
    seconds = secs % 60
    return f"{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}:{seconds:02d}"


def test_stamp_midnight() -> None:
    assert stamp(0) == "00:00:00"


def test_stamp_zero_padded() -> None:
    assert stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"


def test_stamp_last_second_of_day() -> None:
    assert stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"


def test_stamp_wraps_at_day_boundary() -> None:
    assert stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
    assert stamp(86400 + 45296) == "12:34:56"


def test_stamp_negative_wraps_backward() -> None:
    assert stamp(-1) == "23:59:59"
    assert stamp(-86400) == "00:00:00"


def test_stamp_return_shape() -> None:
    out = stamp(1_700_000_000)
    assert len(out) == 8
    assert out[2] == ":" and out[5] == ":"
    assert all(c.isdigit() for i, c in enumerate(out) if i not in (2, 5))
